topic: Tenses – Present Perfect Progressive: Negations in Present Perfect Progressive
title: Present Perfect Progressive: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect Progressive, geçmişte başlayıp şimdiye kadar süren (veya yeni biten) eylemlerin SÜRESİNİ vurgular.
Olumsuz biçim:
• haven't / hasn't + been + fiil-ing
  I haven't been sleeping well lately. (Son zamanlarda iyi uyuyamıyorum.)
  She hasn't been working here for long.
• I/you/we/they → haven't been, he/she/it → hasn't been
• Sık kullanılanlar: lately, recently, for, since
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect Progressive geçmişde başlap, häzire çenli dowam edýän (ýa-da ýaňy gutaran) hereketleriň DOWAMLYLYGYNY nygtaýar.
Ýokluk görnüşi:
• haven't / hasn't + been + işlik-ing
  I haven't been sleeping well lately. (Soňky wagtlar gowy ýatyp bilemok.)
  She hasn't been working here for long.
• I/you/we/they → haven't been, he/she/it → hasn't been
• Köp ulanylýanlar: lately, recently, for, since
explanation.ru:
Present Perfect Progressive подчёркивает ДЛИТЕЛЬНОСТЬ действия, начавшегося в прошлом и продолжающегося до сих пор (или только что закончившегося).
Отрицание:
• haven't / hasn't + been + глагол-ing
  I haven't been sleeping well lately. (В последнее время я плохо сплю.)
  She hasn't been working here for long.
• I/you/we/they → haven't been, he/she/it → hasn't been
• Часто с: lately, recently, for, since

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect Progressive: Present Perfect Progressive – Statements
title: Present Perfect Progressive: Positive Statements

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect Progressive: have/has + been + fiil-ing
• I have been learning English for three years. (Üç yıldır İngilizce öğreniyorum — hâlâ devam ediyor.)
• She has been waiting since 9 o'clock.
• Yeni bitmiş ve izi görülen eylem: You're out of breath. Have you been running?
• for + süre (for two hours), since + başlangıç (since Monday)
• Kısaltma: I've been, she's been.
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect Progressive: have/has + been + işlik-ing
• I have been learning English for three years. (Üç ýyldan bäri iňlis dilini öwrenýärin — henizem dowam edýär.)
• She has been waiting since 9 o'clock.
• Ýaňy gutaran we yzy görünýän hereket: You're out of breath. Have you been running?
• for + dowamlylyk (for two hours), since + başlangyç (since Monday)
• Gysgaltma: I've been, she's been.
explanation.ru:
Present Perfect Progressive: have/has + been + глагол-ing
• I have been learning English for three years. (Учу английский три года — и продолжаю.)
• She has been waiting since 9 o'clock.
• Только что закончившееся действие с видимым результатом: You're out of breath. Have you been running?
• for + период (for two hours), since + начало (since Monday)
• Сокращения: I've been, she's been.

topic: Tenses – Present Perfect Progressive: Sentences and questions in the Present Perfect Progressive
title: Present Perfect Progressive: Statements and Questions

explanation.tr:
Present Perfect Progressive'de soru:
• Have/Has + özne + been + fiil-ing?
  Have you been waiting long? Has it been raining?
• How long ile süre sorma (en yaygın kullanım):
  How long have you been learning English? – For two years.
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.
• What have you been doing? (Ne yapıyordun? / Neyle meşguldün?)
explanation.tk:
Present Perfect Progressive-de sorag:
• Have/Has + eýe + been + işlik-ing?
  Have you been waiting long? Has it been raining?
• How long bilen dowamlylygy soramak (iň ýaýran ulanylyş):
  How long have you been learning English? – For two years.
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.
• What have you been doing? (Näme bilen meşgul bolduň?)
explanation.ru:
Вопросы в Present Perfect Progressive:
• Have/Has + подлежащее + been + глагол-ing?
  Have you been waiting long? Has it been raining?
• How long — вопрос о длительности (самое частое употребление):
  How long have you been learning English? – For two years.
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.
• What have you been doing? (Чем ты занимался?)

topic: Tenses – Future Progressive: Future Progressive – Statements
title: Future Progressive: will be + -ing

explanation.tr:
Future Progressive, gelecekte belli bir anda devam ediyor olacak eylemi anlatır.
• Yapı: will be + fiil-ing (tüm öznelerde aynı)
• This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Istanbul. (Yarın bu saatte İstanbul'a uçuyor olacağım.)
• At 8 pm we'll be having dinner.
• Olumsuz: won't be + fiil-ing → I won't be working on Sunday.
• Planlı/doğal olarak olacak eylemler: I'll be seeing Ali at the meeting anyway.
explanation.tk:
Future Progressive geljekde belli bir pursatda dowam edip durjak hereketi aňladýar.
• Gurluşy: will be + işlik-ing (ähli eýelerde birmeňzeş)
• This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Istanbul. (Ertir şu wagt men Stambula uçup barýan bolaryn.)
• At 8 pm we'll be having dinner.
• Ýokluk: won't be + işlik-ing → I won't be working on Sunday.
• Meýilleşdirilen/tebigy boljak hereketler: I'll be seeing Ali at the meeting anyway.
explanation.ru:
Future Progressive описывает действие, которое будет происходить в определённый момент в будущем.
• Схема: will be + глагол-ing (одинаково для всех лиц)
• This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Istanbul. (Завтра в это время я буду лететь в Стамбул.)
• At 8 pm we'll be having dinner.
• Отрицание: won't be + глагол-ing → I won't be working on Sunday.
• Ожидаемые/запланированные события: I'll be seeing Ali at the meeting anyway.

topic: Tenses – Future Progressive: Future Progressive – Statements and Questions
title: Future Progressive: Statements and Questions

explanation.tr:
Future Progressive'de soru: Will + özne + be + fiil-ing?
• Will you be working tomorrow evening?
• Kibar soru (birinin planını sormak): Will you be using your car tonight? (Arabanı bu akşam kullanacak mısın? — ödünç istemeden önce)
• Wh-soru: What will you be doing at this time next year?
• Kısa cevap: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
explanation.tk:
Future Progressive-de sorag: Will + eýe + be + işlik-ing?
• Will you be working tomorrow evening?
• Sypaýy sorag (biriniň meýilnamasyny soramak): Will you be using your car tonight? (Şu agşam maşynyňy ulanjakmy? — karz soramazdan öň)
• Wh-sorag: What will you be doing at this time next year?
• Gysga jogap: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
explanation.ru:
Вопрос в Future Progressive: Will + подлежащее + be + глагол-ing?
• Will you be working tomorrow evening?
• Вежливый вопрос о планах: Will you be using your car tonight? (Ты будешь пользоваться машиной вечером? — перед тем как попросить её)
• Специальный вопрос: What will you be doing at this time next year?
• Краткий ответ: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
